name: Exp_TrendValue
summary: This EA trades based on the custom TrendValue indicator, opening buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals. It uses ATR-based sensitivity for trend detection and applies fixed stop loss and take profit levels. Trade execution is controlled by new bar detection and configurable permissions for opening and closing positions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义TrendValue指标进行交易，在上升趋势信号时开多仓，下降趋势信号时开空仓。它使用基于ATR的灵敏度进行趋势检测，并设置固定的止损止盈水平。交易执行通过新K线检测和可配置的开平仓权限来控制。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用趋势跟踪策略，核心依赖自定义TrendValue指标（基于移动平均线和ATR构建）判断市场方向。入场条件为：当UpSignal缓冲区出现非空有效值时开多仓，当DnSignal缓冲区出现非空有效值时开空仓。出场条件为：当反向趋势信号出现时平仓（如持仓多仓时出现DnTrend或DnSignal则平多），或触发固定点数的止损止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算手数。资金管理方面，止损默认1000点、止盈默认2000点，盈亏比为2:1，但缺少追踪止损和动态止损机制。策略还加入了历史数据加载检查和新K线过滤机制，避免重复信号。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend-following strategy centered on the custom TrendValue indicator, which is built from moving averages and ATR to determine market direction. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the UpSignal buffer produces a non-empty valid value, and a sell position is opened when the DnSignal buffer produces a non-empty valid value. Exit conditions: positions are closed when opposing trend signals appear (e.g., a long is closed when DnTrend or DnSignal triggers), or when fixed stop loss or take profit levels are hit. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a share of the deposit per deal. Money management features a default stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points, yielding a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio, but lacks trailing stops or dynamic stop adjustments. The strategy also incorporates historical data loading checks and new bar filtering to prevent duplicate signal execution.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款份额或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Trade capital percentage; negative = fixed lots

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格滑点偏差点数
parameters.description_en: Max price deviation in points (slippage tolerance)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，趋势跟踪结合ATR动态灵敏度适应市场波动
提供完整的开平仓权限控制，灵活度高
使用新K线检测避免同一K线内重复交易
盈亏比2:1设计合理，有利于长期正期望值
通过SignalBar参数可灵活选择信号确认的K线位置
pros_en: Clear strategy logic combining trend following with ATR-based dynamic sensitivity to adapt to market volatility
Comprehensive open/close permission controls for both buy and sell sides offer high flexibility
New bar detection prevents duplicate trades within the same bar
2:1 reward-to-risk ratio is well-designed for long-term positive expectancy
SignalBar parameter allows flexible selection of signal confirmation bar index
cons: 完全依赖自定义TrendValue指标，无法在缺少该指标的环境中独立运行
缺少点差过滤和滑点保护，在高波动市场可能导致成交偏差过大
止损止盈为固定点数，未根据ATR动态调整，在不同波动环境下适应性差
未检测当前是否已有持仓，可能导致同方向重复开仓
依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，代码可移植性受限
cons_en: Fully dependent on the custom TrendValue indicator, cannot run independently without it
No spread filter or slippage protection, which may cause excessive execution deviation in volatile markets
Fixed stop loss and take profit in points without ATR-based dynamic adjustment reduces adaptability across varying volatility environments
No check for existing positions before opening new ones, potentially leading to duplicate same-direction entries
Depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, limiting code portability
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致过度风险暴露
将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，提高在不同市场波动环境下的适应性
improvements_en: Add position existence checks before opening new trades to prevent duplicate same-direction entries and excessive risk exposure
Replace fixed stop loss/take profit with ATR-based dynamic calculation for better adaptability across different volatility regimes

risk_points: 缺少持仓检查可能导致同方向重复开仓，增加风险暴露
固定止损止盈在低波动市场可能过宽，在高波动市场可能过窄
依赖外部自定义指标和库文件，运行环境缺失时EA将无法正常工作
risk_points_en: Lack of position checks may cause duplicate same-direction entries, increasing risk exposure
Fixed stop loss/take profit may be too wide in low-volatility markets and too narrow in high-volatility markets
Dependency on external custom indicator and library files means the EA will not function if they are missing
